def load():

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find separator line: full row or full column of one repeated value; take the one present
    sep_r=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1]
    sep_c=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1]
